reason: The i386 corpus exercises x87 stack operations whose current fallback is a maximally opaque LLIR intrinsic.
semantic_risk: Floating-point values, x87 stack depth, status flags, and memory effects are not represented precisely.
removal_condition: Remove or narrow this family as each x87 mnemonic gains a non-opaque LLIR model.

reason: The x87 wait instruction currently reaches the same conservative x87 fallback as the associated floating-point operations.
semantic_risk: Pending x87 exception synchronization is not represented.
removal_condition: Remove when WAIT/FWAIT has an explicit LLIR effect model.

reason: Privileged halt has no user-space value semantics in the current decompiler pipeline.
semantic_risk: Control termination and privilege behavior are represented only conservatively.
removal_condition: Remove when HLT has an explicit terminal or privileged-effect LLIR operation.

reason: The spin-loop hint is intentionally retained as a conservative intrinsic pending a dedicated hint/no-value-effect representation.
semantic_risk: Scheduling and timing intent is not represented, although architectural data state is not fabricated.
removal_condition: Remove when PAUSE is represented by an explicit non-opaque hint operation.

reason: The guaranteed-invalid opcode is not yet represented as an explicit trap terminator.
semantic_risk: Control flow after a guaranteed trap remains only conservatively described.
removal_condition: Remove when UD2 lowers to an explicit non-returning trap operation.

reason: Conditionally executed control effects are conservatively opaque until predication is carried into LLIR.
semantic_risk: The equality guard and conditional control transfer are not represented precisely.
removal_condition: Remove when ARM predicated branch-with-link semantics reach LLIR.

reason: Conditionally executed doubleword loads are conservatively opaque until predication and paired-register effects are modelled together.
semantic_risk: The equality guard, two-register write, and memory read are not represented precisely.
removal_condition: Remove when predicated LDRD has explicit paired-register LLIR semantics.

reason: A conditionally executed coprocessor store is conservatively opaque because the coprocessor state contract is not modelled.
semantic_risk: The less-than-or-equal guard and coprocessor memory effects are not represented precisely.
removal_condition: Remove when predicated STC and its coprocessor state have explicit LLIR semantics.

reason: Conditionally executed doubleword stores are conservatively opaque until predication and paired-register effects are modelled together.
semantic_risk: The equality guard, two-register read, and memory write are not represented precisely.
removal_condition: Remove when predicated STRD has explicit paired-register LLIR semantics.

reason: Supervisor calls require an OS-specific syscall contract that the current target model does not provide.
semantic_risk: Arguments, result registers, clobbers, memory effects, and exceptional control flow are only conservative.
removal_condition: Remove when the target ABI supplies an explicit SVC effect contract.

reason: A conditionally executed supervisor call needs both ARM predication and an OS-specific syscall contract.
semantic_risk: The less-than guard plus syscall arguments, results, clobbers, memory effects, and control behavior are only conservative.
removal_condition: Remove when predication and the target ABI's SVC effect contract both reach LLIR.
